body:
## CI Issue

Three workflows key `concurrency.group` on a value that collapses to the same string for every push to `main`, combined with `cancel-in-progress: true`:

- `.github/workflows/test.yml` — group `${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}`, triggers on `push: branches: [main]`
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` — same group shape, same `push: branches: [main]` trigger
- `.github/workflows/build-iso.yml` — group `${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.ref_name }}`, triggers on `push: branches: [main]` and `workflow_run` (completion of the multi-runner build)

For any of these, two pushes to `main` close together evict each other's in-progress run; the evicted commit's check reports `cancelled`, not a real pass/fail, and is never re-tested.

This repo already fixed the identical problem in `build-tromso-multirunner.yml`:
```yaml
# times a day. cancel-in-progress:true meant every push evicted whatever
...
cancel-in-progress: false
```
— confirming the org already knows this failure mode; these three siblings were missed. Same root cause already filed and fixed-by-recommendation in tuna-os/tacklebox#284, tuna-os/wootc#363, tuna-os/iso-builder#185, tuna-os/tuna-installer-niri#57, tuna-os/xfce-linux#140, tuna-os/bootc-migrate#248, tuna-os/hive#46 — copy-pasted boilerplate across the org, not an isolated mistake.

Separately, `test-luks-install.yml`/`test-plain-install.yml` key on `luks-e2e-${{ github.ref }}` / `plain-e2e-${{ github.ref }}` with no `push` trigger, but they do run on `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`, both of which also resolve `github.ref` to the default branch — so two scheduled/dispatched runs close together can still evict each other. Lower priority here since (per #278/#267) these checks have never passed anyway, but worth fixing at the same time since it's the same one-line change.

## Recommendation

```diff
--- a/.github/workflows/test.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/test.yml
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
-  cancel-in-progress: true
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
```

Same one-line change for `lint.yml`. For `build-iso.yml`, restrict cancellation to manual re-dispatch only:

```diff
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.ref_name }}
-  cancel-in-progress: true
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
```

Blocked from a direct PR by the same `.github/workflows/*.yml` App-permission gap as the sibling repos (tuna-os/hive#5) — diff is inline above for a maintainer to apply directly.
